lines.text: kchsy chydaiin olo l tchey char cfhar am
yteey char or ochydcho lkody okodar chody
da ckhy ckhockhy shydksheey cthy kotchody dal
potoy shol dair cphoaldar chey tody otoaiin shoshy
choky chol ctho l shol okaldolchey chodo lol chy cthy
qo ol choees cheol dol ctheyykol dol dolo ykol do lchiody
okolshol kol kechy chol kychol cthol chody chol daiin
shor okol chol dol ky darshol dchor o tcho dar shody
taor chotchey dal chodyschody pol chodar
